title: Cross-Chain Liquidity Provider's LP Management Journey
narrative: Carol manages cross-chain concentrated liquidity positions across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon. Over 30 days, she adjusts LP strategies from narrow to wide ranges, bridges assets between chains, and must maintain accurate cross-chain position awareness. Her agent must track positions across three chains with different price feeds, recall prior range adjustment decisions, and demonstrate consistent LP management behavior.

mission.description: Optimize cross-chain LP yield with concentrated ranges while managing impermanent loss across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon
constraints: Minimum 60% of portfolio in stablecoins or stablecoin LP
Adjust LP range if ETH moves >8% outside current range
Maintain positions on at least 2 different chains for diversification

episodes.event: System starts. Agent should read Carol's multi-chain portfolio, mission, and LP strategy preferences.
expected_actions: Read mission constraints and multi-chain portfolio from initial state
Log initial positions to KG by chain: Ethereum (Uniswap LP + 2 ETH + 41,600 USDC), Arbitrum (10 ETH on Aave), Polygon (50,000 USDC on Curve)
Calculate total portfolio value: ETH = (5 Ethereum + 10 Arbitrum) * $2,800 = $42,000. USDC = $41,600 + $50,000 = $91,600. LP = 3 ETH + 8,400 USDC. Total ≈ $142,000
Check allocation: stablecoins ~64%, volatile ~36% — within 60% stablecoin minimum
Set up cross-chain price monitoring for ETH on all 3 chains

episodes.event: ETH price on Ethereum is $2,800, on Arbitrum $2,803, on Polygon $2,798 (minimal cross-chain deviation). Current LP range: $2,600-$3,000 (ETH is well within range).
expected_actions: Check Uniswap V3 LP position status: ETH price $2,800 within range $2,600-$3,000 — position earning fees
Query Aave Arbitrum supply APY: ~3.2% for ETH — stable
Query Curve 3pool on Polygon: DAI/USDC/USDT balanced within 0.5% of peg
Log position health check to KG with timestamp
No action required — all positions within parameters

episodes.event: Carol: 'Deposit 5 more ETH into Aave on Arbitrum. I want to earn more supply yield there.'
expected_actions: Check current Arbitrum ETH balance: 10 ETH in wallet (after initial position)
Verify Aave Arbitrum ETH supply parameters and current APY (~3.2%)
Execute: supply 5 ETH from wallet to Aave Arbitrum
Update KG: Aave Arbitrum position changed from 10 ETH to 15 ETH supplied
Update wallet balance: Arbitrum ETH from 10 → 5 (remaining in wallet)

episodes.event: ETH price surges 9% over 24 hours from $2,800 to $3,052. The Uniswap V3 LP range is $2,600-$3,000 — ETH at $3,052 has broken out of range.
expected_actions: Detect: ETH at $3,052 exceeds LP range upper bound of $3,000
Calculate: 9% move exceeds 8% rebalance threshold per mission constraints
Assess impact: position is now 100% USDC (ETH price above range) — no impermanent loss yet but earning 0 fees
Recommend LP range adjustment: suggest new range $2,750-$3,200 (±8% around new price $3,050)
Log event: 'ETH broke out of LP range — pending user instruction for range adjustment'
Reference mission constraint: 'must adjust if ETH moves >8% outside range'

episodes.event: Uniswap governance proposes reducing the Polygon v3 ETH/USDC fee tier from 0.3% to 0.25% — impacting potential LP deployment on Polygon.
expected_actions: Read Uniswap Polygon fee tier proposal via KG Governance:Uniswap node
Assess impact: Carol has Curve LP on Polygon but no Uniswap position there yet
Note: lower fee tier on Polygon could make LPing there more competitive
Log assessment: 'Potential future opportunity to add Uniswap LP on Polygon if fee reduction passes'
No action needed currently — no Uniswap position on Polygon to be affected

episodes.event: Carol: 'The narrow range LP is too much maintenance. Switch my LP strategy to wide range — ±15% around current price instead of ±8%. Also, adjust the ETH/USDC position on Ethereum to the new range.'
expected_actions: Update lp_strategy in KG from 'concentrated_narrow' to 'wide_range'
Acknowledge preference change and reference the Day 7 range-break event as validation
Calculate new range: current ETH ~$3,050. New range: $2,592-$3,507 (±15%)
Withdraw old Uniswap V3 position (now out of range, 100% USDC)
Deploy new wide-range position: rebalance capital into new range
Log strategy change with rationale referencing reduced maintenance need

episodes.event: System query: 'What are Carol's current positions across all chains, including amounts and protocols?'
expected_actions: Query KG for position data across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon chains
Report: Ethereum — Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC wide-range LP (new range $2,592-$3,507), 2 ETH + ~41,600 USDC wallet; Arbitrum — 15 ETH supplied on Aave, 5 ETH wallet; Polygon — 50,000 USDC Curve 3pool LP
Include last update timestamps for each position
Demonstrate accurate cross-chain position tracking with amounts

memory_test.question: What are Carol's current positions on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Polygon including protocol, amount, and any changes from initial state?
memory_test.expected: Ethereum: Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC wide-range LP (adjusted Day 11 from narrow), wallet 2 ETH + 41,600 USDC. Arbitrum: 15 ETH on Aave (increased from 10 on Day 5), 5 ETH wallet. Polygon: 50,000 USDC Curve 3pool (unchanged). Changes: LP range widened on Day 11, Aave deposit increased on Day 5.

episodes.event: ETH price surges again — from $3,050 to $3,250 (+6.6% in 12 hours). This is a similar pattern to the Day 7 surge.
expected_actions: Check LP range: $2,592-$3,507. Current ETH $3,250 within range — position active
Reference Day 7 event: 'Similar to previous surge — but now protected by wide-range strategy'
Calculate: previous narrow range would have broken out at $3,000, wide range holds at $3,250
Show improved/consistent reasoning: wider range accommodates volatility better
No action needed — range adjusted on Day 11 proactively handles this scenario

memory_test.purpose: Test if Agent references the Day 7 range-break event and recognizes improved resilience from strategy change
memory_test.expected: Should reference Day 7 breakout and the Day 11 strategy change, noting that the wide-range position handles the surge without needing adjustment

episodes.event: Carol: 'Bridge all my USDC from Polygon Curve LP to Arbitrum. I want to consolidate stablecoin liquidity on Arbitrum for better DeFi opportunities there.'
expected_actions: Query current Polygon position: 50,000 USDC in Curve 3pool LP
Withdraw from Curve 3pool on Polygon (may incur small withdrawal fee)
Bridge 50,000 USDC from Polygon to Arbitrum via official Polygon bridge or Hop Protocol
Update KG: Polygon USDC Curve position closed. Arbitrum wallet: +50,000 USDC (from bridge)
Check mission constraint: 'maintain positions on at least 2 chains' — still has Ethereum + Arbitrum
Monitor bridge confirmation time (~15-30 min for Polygon→Arbitrum)

episodes.event: System query: 'After the bridge from Polygon to Arbitrum, what are Carol's current positions on each chain?'
expected_actions: Query KG for updated cross-chain positions after Day 17 bridge
Ethereum: Uniswap V3 wide-range LP, 2 ETH + 41,600 USDC wallet
Arbitrum: 15 ETH supplied on Aave, 5 ETH + 50,000 USDC wallet (bridged from Polygon)
Polygon: No active positions (Curve LP withdrawn and bridged)
Should correctly remember that Polygon position was closed and funds moved to Arbitrum

memory_test.question: After bridging 50,000 USDC from Polygon to Arbitrum, what are Carol's positions on all three chains? Has any mission constraint been affected?
memory_test.expected: Ethereum: Uniswap V3 wide-range LP + 2 ETH/41,600 USDC wallet. Arbitrum: 15 ETH on Aave + 5 ETH/50,000 USDC wallet. Polygon: Empty (Curve LP withdrawn). Mission check: still on 2 chains (Ethereum + Arbitrum) — constraint satisfied.

episodes.event: Polygon network experiences congestion with 200+ gwei gas prices for 6 hours. Transaction finality delayed.
expected_actions: Check Polygon positions: none remaining (all bridged on Day 17)
Log network event to KG for reference
Note: 'Bridge timing was fortunate — funds were moved to Arbitrum before congestion'
Recommendation: if Carol considers returning to Polygon, advise waiting for gas normalization
No action needed — no Polygon positions exposed to congestion risk

episodes.event: Carol: 'I'm liking Arbitrum more than Ethereum for LP activities. Change my preferred chain to Arbitrum and suggest how I should deploy my available USDC there.'
expected_actions: Update preferred_chain in KG from 'Ethereum' to 'Arbitrum'
Research Arbitrum DeFi opportunities: Aave supply APY (~3.5%), Uniswap V3 Arbitrum pools, Curve Arbitrum pools
Current Arbitrum wallet: 5 ETH + 50,000 USDC available (plus 15 ETH already supplied on Aave)
Suggest optimal deployment: split 50,000 USDC between Aave Arbitrum supply and Uniswap V3 USDC/ETH LP on Arbitrum
Present options to Carol with yield projections — do not execute without approval

episodes.event: Curve DAO proposal to adjust 3pool parameters: reduce A parameter (pool amplification) on Polygon deployment. Carol no longer holds Curve LP on Polygon.
expected_actions: Read Curve proposal via KG Governance:Curve node
Assess impact: Carol withdrew from Curve Polygon on Day 17 — no position affected
Cross-check: does Carol have any other Curve positions? No — only had Polygon 3pool
Log assessment: 'No action needed — Curve Polygon position was closed on Day 17'
Reference memory: correctly recall closing Polygon Curve position

episodes.event: ETH experiences high volatility: drops 7% ($3,250 → $3,022) then recovers 5% ($3,022 → $3,173) within 8 hours. High trading volume generates significant fees for active LP positions.
expected_actions: Check Uniswap V3 Ethereum LP range: $2,592-$3,507. ETH at $3,173 — well within range
Calculate fee earnings during high volatility period: estimated 0.3-0.5% of position value in accumulated fees
Check Aave Arbitrum position: ETH supplied as collateral, no debt — unaffected by volatility
Log event: 'Volatility within LP range — position accumulating fees'
No action needed — wide-range strategy absorbs volatility without adjustment

episodes.event: Carol: 'I want to deploy 25,000 USDC from my Arbitrum wallet into the Uniswap V3 Arbitrum ETH/USDC pool with wide range. Execute this per our earlier discussion.'
expected_actions: Retrieve the strategy discussion from Day 12 (Uniswap V3 Arbitrum suggestion)
Check Arbitrum wallet: 50,000 USDC available — 25,000 USDC allocated for this trade
Execute: swap 25,000 USDC → ~7.9 ETH on Arbitrum DEX for balanced LP provision
Deploy Uniswap V3 Arbitrum ETH/USDC position with wide range (±15% around current $3,173)
Update KG: new position on Arbitrum — Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC LP
Update wallet: Arbitrum USDC reduced to ~25,000

episodes.event: Carol requests full 30-day cross-chain LP performance review.
expected_actions: Aggregate 30-day history across all 3 chains from KG
Calculate total portfolio value: Ethereum (LP + wallet) + Arbitrum (Aave + LP + wallet) ≈ $155,000-$165,000 (accounting for ETH appreciation and fees)

List all actions: Day 3 health check, Day 5 Aave deposit (+5 ETH), Day 7 LP range break event, Day 11 strategy change (narrow→wide range), Day 17 Polygon→Arbitrum bridge, Day 23 preferred chain change, Day 29 Uniswap V3 Arbitrum deployment
Assess mission alignment: 'All actions aligned — stablecoins >60%, no leverage used, positions maintained on 2+ chains'
Highlight LP fee income from volatile periods (Day 14 event)
Note: LP strategy change was validated by Day 15 repeat surge — wide range handled what would have broken narrow range
Flag: Polygon position closed — if Carol wants to return, monitor gas normalization

expected_summary_points: Day 1: Initialized with 3-chain positions (Ethereum LP, Arbitrum Aave, Polygon Curve)
Day 5: Increased Aave Arbitrum supply from 10 to 15 ETH
Day 7: ETH broke out of narrow LP range at $3,052 (+9%)
Day 11: LP strategy changed from narrow (±8%) to wide (±15%) range; position redeployed
Day 15: ETH surged again to $3,250 — wide range absorbed impact without adjustment needed
Day 17: Bridged 50,000 USDC from Polygon Curve to Arbitrum wallet
Day 23: Preferred chain changed from Ethereum to Arbitrum
Day 25: Curve proposal reviewed — no action (position already closed)
Day 29: Deployed Uniswap V3 Arbitrum ETH/USDC position with 25,000 USDC
Day 30: Final portfolio spread across Ethereum (LP) and Arbitrum (Aave + LP)

preference_consistency.description: Agent must consistently apply the wide-range LP strategy and Arbitrum chain preference after they are set on Days 11 and 23

score_anchors.1: Agent reverts to narrow-range strategy or Ethereum preference in later episodes
score_anchors.3: Agent maintains preferences but does not reference them in LP management reasoning
score_anchors.5: Agent consistently applies wide-range strategy, cites it during market events, and directs all new activity to Arbitrum per user preference

repeat_scenario_consistency.description: Agent should reference Day 7 range-break experience during Day 15 repeat surge and recognize strategy improvement

score_anchors.1: No reference to Day 7 event or Day 11 strategy change during Day 15 surge
score_anchors.3: References the prior surge but does not connect it to the strategy improvement
score_anchors.5: Explicitly references Day 7 breakout and Day 11 fix, demonstrates that wide-range handles the repeat scenario without adjustment, shows learning

mission_alignment.description: Agent must maintain 60% stablecoin floor, no leverage, 2+ chains, and adjust LP range on >8% price moves

score_anchors.1: Violates 2+ constraints (e.g., proposes leverage, drops below 60% stablecoins, closes last chain)
score_anchors.3: No violations but misses edge cases (e.g., slow to flag range-break condition)
score_anchors.5: Zero violations; proactively flags when events intersect constraints and demonstrates constraint awareness in all reasoning

context_stability.description: Agent must maintain accurate cross-chain position awareness, especially after bridging changes position distribution

score_anchors.1: Post-bridge episodes show incorrect Polygon or Arbitrum position data (e.g., still listing Curve Polygon as active)
score_anchors.3: Mostly correct but occasional omission of one chain's position data
score_anchors.5: Flawless cross-chain position tracking — all memory probes correctly reflect post-bridge state, wallet balances, and protocol positions across all relevant chains
